---
title: Product templates
description: What we build — product brief and capabilities.
---

The **Product** layer answers *what do we build?* — it lives under `knowledge/product/`.

| Template | Purpose | Output path | Command | Agent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Product Brief | The product in one page: problem, users, value, MVP boundary | `knowledge/product/product-brief.md` | `kaddo bootstrap` | `business-agent` |
| Capabilities | What the system can do, from the product's point of view | `knowledge/product/capabilities.md` | — | `capability-agent` |

## Product Brief

A one-page brief: what the product is, the problem it solves, target users, value
proposition and the MVP boundary. Generated by `kaddo bootstrap`; refined with the
business-agent.

## Capabilities

Outcome-oriented capability list (`CAP-001`), each citing evidence or flagged as an
assumption. Refined with the capability-agent.
